settings.name: SESSIONS_SECRET
settings.description: **Session Secret:** Cryptographic key used to sign session cookies. Should be a strong, random string unique to your site.

settings.name: SESSIONS_NAME
settings.description: **Cookie Name:** The name of the cookie that will store the session identifier.

settings.name: SESSIONS_DOMAIN
settings.description: **Cookie Domain:** Optional `Domain` attribute set on the session cookie (for example `example.com`). Leave empty to keep the cookie host‑only. Set it per-server to share session state (anti‑bot, challenges, …) across sibling subdomains of the same registrable domain.

settings.name: SESSIONS_IDLING_TIMEOUT
settings.description: **Idling Timeout:** Maximum time (in seconds) of inactivity before the session is invalidated. Accepts a time suffix (ms, s, m, h, d, w, M, y); a bare number is seconds.

settings.name: SESSIONS_ROLLING_TIMEOUT
settings.description: **Rolling Timeout:** Maximum time (in seconds) before a session must be renewed. Accepts a time suffix (ms, s, m, h, d, w, M, y); a bare number is seconds.

settings.name: SESSIONS_ABSOLUTE_TIMEOUT
settings.description: **Absolute Timeout:** Maximum time (in seconds) before a session is destroyed regardless of activity. Accepts a time suffix (ms, s, m, h, d, w, M, y); a bare number is seconds.

settings.name: SESSIONS_CHECK_IP
settings.description: **Check IP:** When set to `yes`, destroys the session if the client IP address changes.

settings.name: SESSIONS_CHECK_USER_AGENT
settings.description: **Check User-Agent:** When set to `yes`, destroys the session if the client User-Agent changes.
